نتضايق (form VI)
# نَتَضَايَقُ (nataḍāyaqu) /na.ta.dˤaː.ja.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَضَايَقَ (taḍāyaqa)
# نَتَضَايَقَ (nataḍāyaqa) /na.ta.dˤaː.ja.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَضَايَقَ (taḍāyaqa)
# نَتَضَايَقْ (nataḍāyaq) /na.ta.dˤaː.jaq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَضَايَقَ (taḍāyaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
